caseName: United Gas Public Service Co. v. Texas
caseNameFull: United Gas Public Service Co. v. Texas

opinions.text: It is ordered that the opinion in this cause be amended by striking out the period after the words “and return” in line 3, on page 14, and inserting the words “for the period to which the evidence before the Court appropriately related and not simply for the years 1932 and 1933.” The petition for rehearing is denied. Reported as amended, ante, p. 123.
